programme.title: Žert
programme.desc: Filmová adaptace stejnojmenného románu Milana Kundery o nevydařené pomstě za politickou persekuci. Univerzitní posluchač Ludvík Jahn pošle z jakéhosi školení své dívce a zároveň kolegyni pohlednici, na níž mimo jiné napsal: Optimismus je opium lidstva! Zdravý duch páchne blbostí. Ať žije Trockij! A protože se píší léta padesátá, následky na sebe nenechají dlouho čekat.

programme.title: Poklad v pyramidě
programme.desc: Statečný Lucius a krásná Lea ve společném boji proti zvrhlým lupičům. Epizoda ze slavného animovaného seriálu hororů - Smrtící vůně. Výtvarník František Braun. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (47)
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken - not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (48)
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (32)
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (33)
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (34)
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (35)
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (36)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (37)
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams of drinking some nice cold coconut milk on the couch. Step one, get rid of the Lemmings who are having fun flying through the living room. Two, find coconuts that haven't been emptied of their nectar. While Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts that are too high up, the Lemmings find a magic conch. By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (38)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (39)
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with "laser" party favors and are propelled onto an "unknown planet": a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (40)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (41)
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (42)
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (43)
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (44)
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (46)
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (40)
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (41)
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)

Další zkoušky a zkoumání potvrdily to, že povrch Měsíce je značně narušen a je nestabilní - hrozí zničení veškerého života na Zemi. Jak letí čas, tým odborníků se obrátí na demoličního experta Johna Reddinga s žádostí o pomoc, aby nalezl řešení, a hlavně zachránil Měsíc.

Fotograf Patrick dostal znenadání dopis od své sestry Caroline, bývalé narkomanky, ve kterém ho zve do své náboženské komunity na místo Eden Parish. Jeho dva kolegové novináři letí helikoptérou s ním, aby natočili o cestě dokument. Po příjezdu jsou nejdříve překvapeni společenstvím šťastných lidí, které vede Otec.

Do toho Tara mnohdy spatřuje děsivé entity, díky kterým si není jistá vlastním duševním zdravím a díky čemuž odkrývá šokující historii své rodiny. Americký horor

Čeká tam na ni bývalý přítel, který ji kdysi zradil a opustil, ale také nostalgie, vzpomínky a ztracené sny. Podivná noc, podivní hospodští hosté a šokující ranní probuzení. Nic už nebude jako dřív! V každé epizodě budeme pozorovat život a chování vybraného zvířátka a vysvětlovat důležitost rostlinky, která s ním souvisí. Vydejte se i vy spolu s námi na dobrodružnou poznávací jízdu! Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Pojďte pane, budeme si hrát (10)
programme.desc: Kreslený seriál o dvojici medvědů, kdy jeden je malý a hloupoučký. Druhý protáhlý a vychytralý s mlsným jazýčkem. Jednoho dne se potkali u Kolína a dali se do řeči. Po dlouhém klábosení o tom, jak měli geniální předky a příbuzné zjistí, že jsou bráchové a začnou si spolu hrát. Prožívají spolu mnohá dobrodružství a hry, které však nejsou ze strany toho většího zrovna čestnou zábavou. Ale malý medvídek to snáší vcelku dobře, a tak oba navozují řadu úsměvných situací...

programme.title: O Dorotce (2)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (2)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (1)
programme.desc: Mach a Šebestová hlídají malé miminko. Dají ho do kočárku na balkon. Aby jim nevypadlo, pomocí kouzelného sluchátka mu přičarují křídla. Ale jejich problémy nekončí. Dítě odletí a létá po městě. Československý animovaný seriál (1976-1983).

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (5)
programme.desc: U Maříkova žila chudá vdova, které všichni říkali Dontovka. Na krku měla kupu dětí, a tak dřela od rána do večera. Když jednou sekala louku, šel kolem Krakonoš a dostal chuť na jahody. Ale to si dal! Dontovka ho hnala bez respektu pryč, a to Krakonoše jaksepatří rozzlobilo. Přičaroval jí mohutné vousy a myslel si, bůhvíjak na ni nevyzrál. Jenomže kampak na Dontovku. Okamžitě zarůstající vousy stříhala a spolu s dětmi vyráběla košťata, koberce, záclony. A ženské v okolí popadla závist.

programme.title: Žíznivé mládí
programme.desc: Příběh kouzelné doby procitajícího mládí. Poetický příběh prvního citového vzplanutí dospívajících. Jarek, nemanželský syn chudé chalupnice, se zamiluje do převozníkovy dcery Lidušky. Oba mladé lidi poznamenaly těžké životní podmínky a bezútěšné prostředí. Přesto věří své lásce, která musela projít těžkými zkouškami. I zcela nemajetná mládež, tvrdě poznamenaná svým původem, se může zamilovat, jak se stalo nemanželskému synu udřené chalupnice a převozníkově dceři.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Hořký podzim s vůní manga
programme.desc: Tragická událost ze života filmové režisérky pátrající na dvou kontinentech po stopách Džaváharlála Néhrúa. Česká filmařka Anna Hettlová natáčí dokument o indickém státníkovi Džaváharlálovi Néhrúovi (1889-1964). Ten kdysi navštívil i Československo a varoval politiky před důsledky mnichovské dohody. Režisérka objevuje fotografii, která ji dovede k muži, jenž se Néhrúa marně snažil přesvědčit o jednání s nacisty.

programme.title: Spravedlnosti se meze nekladou
programme.desc: Tragikomický příběh dobrého soudce z období první republiky na motivy povídky Ivana Olbrachta. Dobrý soudce Engelbert Bezloja se pro svou nestrannost dostane do nesnází. Osobní důvody a dluhy přispějí k tomu, že odejde na zastrčený post. Redaktor Pekárek, kterého kdysi osvobodil, ho nachází v Beranovicích. Rád by se mu odvděčil, a tak o něm napíše potupný článek jako o zlém a krutém sadistovi. Mezitím se Bezloja zaplete s místní chudinou a vrchní rada Kunz ho definitivně zbaví úřadu.

programme.title: Návrat
programme.desc: Záhadný telefonát, který zastihne písničkářku Sáru na klubovém vystoupení, ji přiměje vyhledat ještě před půlnocí osamělou hospůdku ve vesničce za Prahou. Čeká tam na ni bývalý přítel, který ji kdysi zradil a opustil, ale také nostalgie, vzpomínky a ztracené sny. Podivná noc, podivní hospodští hosté a šokující ranní probuzení. Nic už nebude jako dřív! Český krátkometrážní psychologický horor

programme.title: Kudy kráčela smrt (6)
programme.desc: Bylo mu teprve patnáct roků, když se - společně s rodiči a starší sestrou - ocitl v těsném dosahu Smrti. Chtěli této Smrti uniknout. Vydali se tedy na hazardní cestu plnou nebezpečí. Žili v zemljankách, na půdách a v dalších úkrytech. Pronásledováni zimou, hladem, strachem. Po celou tu dobu se o ně staralo několik odvážných lidí, kteří riskovali nejenom své životy, ale také životy svých nejbližších. Téměř tři roky balancovali Wolfovi i jejich přátelé na okraji pomyslné propasti.

programme.title: Pod jednou střechou
programme.desc: Malostranský příběh o bohatém domácím, jeho synovi, chudé květinářce a chápající a přející moudré babičce. Bohatý stavitel, majitel několika domů, nemá rád chudé podnájemníky, zvláště když neplatí činži. Ale ještě větší potíže mu přichystá syn, když se zamiluje do zcela nemajetné květinářky. Komedie podle stejnojmenné povídky Ignáta Herrmana. Populární operetní tenor Jára Pospíšil zpívá Pod střechami Malé Strany a Láska, panebože, láska. Československá komedie

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Divoké pivo
programme.desc: Legrace se daří, kde se pivo vaří. Ztřeštěná komedie o privatizaci pivovaru, české mafii a policajtech. Bláznivá letní komedie o privatizaci malého jihočeského pivovaru, v níž figuruje i půvabná pohádková bytost ženského pohlaví. V řadě komediálních situací se zde setkávají dobří čeští policisté s mafií, poctiví občané s podvodníky. Úsměvný příběh, který samozřejmě nepostrádá milostnou zápletku, významně ovlivní pohádkové bytosti, které se náhle vynoří z dávné minulosti.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Dobrý voják Švejk
programme.desc: Nejznámější český hrdina vyráží do boje za císaře pána. První část dvoudílné adaptace nesmrtelného románu Jaroslava Haška Osudy dobrého vojáka Švejka, kterou v letech 1956 a 1957 natočil režisér Karel Steklý. Svérázného hrdinu, který se pro horlivé plnění příkazů nadřízených stává pohromou pro své okolí, ztvárnil nezapomenutelný Rudolf Hrušínský.

programme.title: Daleká cesta
programme.desc: Svědectví z terezínského ghetta. Strhující příběh o osudu židovské rodiny, zavlečené do terezínského ghetta. Mladá židovská lékařka se na počátku okupace provdá za „rasově čistého“ českého kolegu, aby si zachránila život. Její rodiče se však už nepodaří zachránit, jsou zavlečeni s prvními transporty lidí do terezínského ghetta. Film natočil slavný divadelní režisér Alfréd Radok v roce 1948.

programme.title: Noc v motelu Marion
programme.desc: Krátký snímek vypráví o jedné noci v motelu, v němž dva mladé milence - Jonáše a Gabrielu navštíví neznámý cizinec, jenž se vydává za údržbáře. Jeho podivné chování však naznačuje, že noc nakonec nebude tak romantická, jak si zřejmě představovali. Český krátkometrážní horor

programme.desc: Vycházku po německých hudebních centrech bude provázet hudba Richarda Wagnera, Richarda Strausse, Johannesa Brahmse a Gustava Mahlera (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (49)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (50)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him - but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all - no Teddy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (47)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (48)
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic stick that functions as a Yummy divining rod. Grizzy steals their stick and finds a Yummy deposit in the savanna. To take control over Grizzy’s discovery, the Lemmings set a trap to draw the bear far from the deposit and transform it into an industrial chocolate factory. Grizzy will want to recover his chocolate deposit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (51)
programme.desc: An eclipse prevents the solar panels from supplying the cabin with electricity and Grizzy is disgruntledbecause he can’t watch TV. When he discovers that the Lemmings are using fireflies to have a party withoutelectricity, Grizzy evicts the Lemmings and recovers the fireflies to fuel the solar panels. The Lemmingshappen upon a jewel that gives them total control over the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (52)
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor but before they can enjoy it Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the keyring that came as a gift. The Lemmings aren’t interested until the keyring lands in a magic vial which gives it an extraordinary power: stick the keyring onto any object and it will shrink to the size of a plastic miniature figurine!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (53)
programme.desc: Grizzy is jealous of the Lemmings’ new game: an interactive dance mat connected to the TV where the idea is to jump around and perform dance sequences. As they fight over the mat, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a hidden mechanism in one of the Great Wall of China’s watchtowers. The mechanism activates a game on the wall’s paving stones that is similar to the interactive mat, only life size. On your marks, get ready, dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (54)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are hungry! While fighting over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the jar is destroyed. But Grizzy discovers an ingenious manner to recover the remains of another Yummy jar using instant Chinese noodles as inspiration. The result is delicious. Grizzy and the Lemmings will once again fight over this new Yummy-based recipe: Choco-noodles.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (55)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings, who are both starving, discover a temple dedicated to an ancestral brioche. According to the book lying open inside the temple, to obtain a perfect brioche you must gather three gold ingredients and set them on the altar. When the panda idol who guards the temple receives the offering, the person will receive his favorite food in abundance. Grizzy and Lemmings set out to find the sacred ingredients but there is no question of working together. May the best critter win!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (56)
programme.desc: An integrated circuit containing an artificial intelligence accidentally connects to Grizzy’s stuffed teddy bear, which comes to life like a modern-day Pinocchio. Grizzy educates the chip until it decides to connect to the Lemmings’ robot to play with them. When the AI becomes a teenager, it is no longer interested in either Grizzy or the Lemmings and prefers using a smartphone to keep learning.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (57)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a large silkworm that produces an extremely soft and resilient elastic thread ad infinitum. The Lemmings consider the worm the ideal game companion, but Grizzy needs the worm to make his knitwear. To become masters of the silkworm, the close enemies will go to harsh extremes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (58)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a crate of cell phones: there’s one for everyone. But before being able to play with their new toys, they need to charge the batteries. This operation uses all the electricity stored in the cabin’s solar battery and prevents Grizzy from watching TV. Grizzy soon realizes that this is the least of his worries, for living with the Lemmings and their phones is a guaranteed nonstop stream of noise pollution.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (59)
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires in abundance. All you need to do is set the grasshopper on its head while concentrating hard on what you want. As discretion is not the Lemmings’ strong point, Grizzy ends up understanding where their profusion of toys is coming from. Grizzy decides that it’s his turn to hunt down the grasshopper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (60)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a new passion: magic Chinese lanterns that they use for sound and light performances. Grizzy is not very enthusiastic about this new electric activity which keeps him from sleeping. While Grizzy thinks that he got rid of their lanterns, the Lemmings discover new high-tech lanterns capable of making even more of a ruckus.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (61)
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console that lets you play life-sized games in the real world. The console emits magical streams of energy that randomly pick avatars to confront one another. Grizzy is chosen as the hero. He must leap onto platforms and confront both enemies and a fearsome leader: a panda equipped with bamboo sticks. The Lemmings are obviously in control of the joystick!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (44)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (45)
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (46)
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden - a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (47)
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken - not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Moley (51)
programme.desc: It’s the anniversary of Moley becoming the keeper of Manny, and Dotty, with a little help from her Uncle Mishmosh, goes back in time to see what she had missed before she came to MoleTown.

programme.title: Moley (52)
programme.desc: Dotty, now stuck in the past and with nobody recognising her, goes to her uncle for help and they must work together to bring her back to present-day MoleTown without interfering with the past.

programme.title: Moley (1)
programme.desc: When a cell phone falls into Roley Poley park from the Great Above, the entire town is mesmerized by it and Moley must break the “spell” it has on them.

programme.title: Moley (2)
programme.desc: When Moley gets in over his head when he enters a spicy chili eating contest, Manny accidentally makes the chili come alive!

programme.title: Moley (3)
programme.desc: When Moley’s Keeper duties are pulling him in too many directions, he gets Manny to create multiple Moleys!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (7)
programme.desc: A series of spooky sounds and sights leads the Batwheels to believe that the Batcave is haunted by a B-B-Bat-Ghost!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (46)
programme.desc: When Chep asks Mush-Mush and Lilit to go storm-watching and they refuse, Lilit feels bad and convinces Mush-Mush to join their friend. But there are no storms on the horizon. When they notice Chanterelle going through the forest mysteriously, our Mushlers decide to find out what she’s up to instead. That’s when a big storm starts brewing on the horizon...

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (47)
programme.desc: Fung and Miff have come across a rare piece of bark struck by lightning. Chep desperately wants to add it to his collection, but Fung and Miff have no intention to give it to him. Now remembering every time Chep has been nice to them, Fung and Miff end up doing something they never thought possible…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (48)
programme.desc: Chep knows so many things about nature that Mush-Mush and Lilit are confident he’s not far from being an expert like Mushpot. So, when Travel Snail seems unwell, Mush-Mush and Lilit encourage their friend to take care of her in Mushpot’s absence. Chep’s diagnosis takes everyone by surprise: Travel Snail is expecting baby snails! At least that’s what Chep is convinced about…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (49)
programme.desc: Chep has been watching Sushi-Mushi test new compost fritters recipes. When Mush-Mush gets to taste one, he can’t believe it: Sushi-Mushi has cooked the perfect fritter. He tells the news to everyone in Mushton and now, all the Mushables want to taste the perfect fritter too! Only problem is the pressure is so high Sushi-Mushi can’t remember the recipe anymore…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (1)
programme.desc: The Mushlers lead Sushi-Mushi to believe that Pickled Swampost is Mushpot’s favourite dish when he can't stand it. Now they must try to stop Sushi-Mushi from serving this horrible food to Mushpot!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (32)
programme.desc: Power Punch signs up for the strength tournament and blows everyone away. But his power causes an earthquake that threatens to destroy Kaboom City.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (39)
programme.desc: Tom's planned afternoon rendezvous with Toodles goes off the tracks when the mouse-obsessed Toodles catches a glimpse of Tuffy and Jerry. Despite Tom's best efforts to keep her focus on him, her accident-prone ways force him to choose between romance and self-preservation.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (40)
programme.desc: While Rick and Ginger are away, an overly ambitious young housesitter ruins Tom's plans to rule the roost. Of course, Jerry delights in Tom's predicament…until the sitter spots the mouse, and he becomes enemy numero uno!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (39)
programme.desc: Hildie and Beatie bring home a fortune-telling magic mirror. When it shows Tom a future he doesn't like, he tries everything to avoid it. In fact, everything that Tom does to avoid his future only seems to make it worse.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (22)
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry have to go retrieve an ingredient for the witches' spell before sundown. Tom sees Princess Toodles and quickly forgets the mission. He competes with Butch in three trials to win over Toodles. Jerry struggles to keep them on track and to help Tom out with the competition.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (73)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a top-secret Canadian Army prototype that allows you to pass through solid surfaces for a window of several seconds.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (74)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have found an Amerindian eagle amulet that endows he who wears it with the powers of a bird of prey. Grizzy would like to impress his beloved she-bear by soaring majestically through the sky. But to confiscate the magic totem from the Lemmings, who are now as sharp as eagles, Grizzy will have to use the cunning... of a puma.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (75)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with the ranger's electric guitar and the cabin walls tremble with their experimental rock. Just as Grizzy is about to destroy the instrument, he realizes it can make harmonious sounds too. Will this be enough to seduce the she-bear he's in love with?

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (21)
programme.desc: The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (22)
programme.desc: Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (10)
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a rare book - the Teddy Bear Haunting - in a bookshop, but it’s too expensive to buy. He secretly tries to read it in the shop… until he’s thrown out. To his dismay someone else then buys the book - so he follows the buyer around trying to read over his shoulder. Will Mr Bean manage to get to the end of the book before getting spotted?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (11)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines - and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: Baby Chipmunk is trying to carry a ton of nuts back to her den, but climbing down the cliff with all her nuts is proving a complex task. As for the baby lemmings, they've discovered the principle of the slide and are having fun building a longer and longer one. When the baby chipmunk sees this, she sees a great opportunity to get her nuts down more cheaply.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.title: Batwheels (17)
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Batwheels (36)
programme.desc: Much to everyone’s surprise, Bam is secretly afraid of the dark. When Poison Ivy knocks out all the power in Gotham, Bam must conquer his fears to stop her.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (25)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock - Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (26)
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive - but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (16)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wakes up on a freezing cold winter’s morning to discover that the boiler is broken and no sign of the repairman. He tries increasingly ridiculous ways to warm up his tea his toothpaste and himself before venturing out to discover somewhere to hunker down and get warm.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (35)
programme.desc: Conned by a mechanic into believing his beloved car to be beyond repair, Mr. Bean reluctantly consigns his faithful four-wheeled friend to the car crusher. After choosing hot-air ballooning as an alternative mode of transport, he spots his cherished car from the air… with the unscrupulous mechanic whistling at the wheel! This discovery raises more than Mr. Bean’s spirits.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (45)
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (17)
programme.desc: Irma wants a romantic break; Bean doesn’t. It’s too expensive. Irma kidnaps Teddy and refuses to give him back unless Bean promises to take her to Paris. Caught between his inability to pay and his love of Teddy Bean doesn’t know what to do! Until he spots a cat beauty competition in which first prize is a romantic break in Paris - if only he can catch Scrapper …

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (13)
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (14)
programme.desc: The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (61)
programme.desc: Exasperated by the Lemmings who prevent him from watching his favorite TV show in peace, Grizzy catapults them out of the cabin. One of them passes through the northern lights and undergoes a strange mutation: he now has the power to control metal with his mind.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (62)
programme.desc: A strange new object figures prominently in the cabin: a big wall clock that resembles a Swiss cuckoo. Grizzy instantly falls in love with the regular "tick-tock," which comforts and soothes him. But when the hands strike noon, figurines come out and perform a song and dance with a flourish. The Lemmings notice that by turning the hands of the clock manually, it can be noontime every two seconds.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (63)
programme.desc: Woken with a start by a nightmare filled with Lemmings, Grizzy stumbles on the Ranger's dream machine. It's a headphone set where you can program the theme of your choice before falling asleep within seconds for a night filled with sweet dreams. But who could possibly sleep soundly surrounded by Lemmings who want their fair share too?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (64)
programme.desc: Grizzy happens onto an old American India medallion bearing the symbol of the wind. He who wears it has the power to command air streams. Grizzy would be quite content to never leave the sofa again and control things from a distance, but the Lemmings want it to create fantastic new games that literally blow you away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (65)
programme.desc: A magic horn lands on the muzzle of a moose, endowing it with grace and the ability to fly. It soars off, leaving a rainbow-colored streak in its wake. When Grizzy sees this strange creature, he dreams of taming it as a gift for his beloved she-bear, while the Lemmings imagine themselves playing rodeo on a bucking unicorn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (66)
programme.desc: A magic horn lands on the muzzle of a moose, endowing it with grace and the ability to fly. Grizzy decided to catch him for impressing she bear while lemmings wants to play on it.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (3)
programme.desc: Tom is making pastries at the bakery. He takes Jerry and Tuffy and puts them in the pastries. Tuffy and Jerry both escape and make a pastry of their own, scaring Tom away.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (4)
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (42)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (52)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is over the moon when he meets Mr. Pod because both men have so much in common; same shirt, jacket, trousers and underpants. And to top it all, Pod is Bean’s spitting image! Bean falls to Earth with a bump, though, when his girlfriend, Irma Gobb, finds Mr. Pod much better looking than him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (5)
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill. As the snow falls outside Mr Bean’s flat becomes so cold that there are ice cubes in his bath water. Mr Bean has the idea to build a huge wind turbine in the back garden providing his own power. All is going very well until an unexpected storm sends Bean’s wind turbine into overdrive creating a huge surge of electricity and a huge shock for everyone

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (6)
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his local bakery to buy a cake but finds he doesn’t have any money. He goes to the bank to use the cash machine but he can’t remember his pin number. When Mr Bean's bankcard is swallowed up by the cash machine there’s only one thing to do - go into the machine and fetch it back. The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (7)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets and all the people who drop litter so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town. Armed with several bin bags Mr Bean collects all the rubbish and puts up his own ‘No Littering’ signs - which have absolutely no effect. When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

programme.title: Batwheels (11)
programme.desc: Bibi and Batgirl team up with the fabulous magician of the Justice League, Zatana, and her amazing magic-using car, Presto!

programme.title: Batwheels (27)
programme.desc: After Kitty the Catmobile saves Bam when he's in a tight spot, Bam decides to take her on a ride along patrol in the hopes of recruiting her as a Batwheel - if he can convince her to stop playing long enough to focus on their mission!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (16)
programme.desc: Bibi guides the audience through an interactive workout featuring jumping, spinning, and other athletic feats!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (12)
programme.desc: Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans - and the team! Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (13)
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (14)
programme.desc: The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Like usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter! The Lemmings have requisitioned the cabin for a party and barricaded themselves inside. Grizzy has no intention of waiting for an invitation to find a way to get in.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (51)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano in the garage at any cost, for the Lemmings love using it to make a dissonant racket. But when he happens to notice that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of "Für Elise" he decides to learn the learn the piece like a real pro.

programme.title: Lamput (46)
programme.desc: It's Specs big night in the town with the lady of his dream. What could go wrong? The answer to that question might have do with the shapeshifting orange blob at the next table.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (23)
programme.desc: Deep in the jungle, chaos erupts when a pair of raptors ambush the kids. Nick se Samanthou mají kromě milostné aférky společného mnohem více - podvodný projekt, na kterém vydělají miliony dolarů.

programme.title: Arthur: Prokletí
programme.desc: Alex je už od dětství fanoušek filmu Arthur a Minimojové. Na svoje narozeniny ho jeho nejlepší přátelé překvapí a vezmou do domu, kde se film točil. Nikdo z nich netuší, že jde o zlověstnou a smrtelnou past. Z dětského snu se brzy stává hrůzná noční můra. Francouzský horor

programme.title: MalinyJAMológia
programme.desc: Malované videoklipy kapely MalinyJAM milují děti na celém Slovensku. Miňo a Paťo z kapely MalinyJAM vynalezli novou vědeckou disciplínu zvanou MalinyJAMologie, jež má umožnit dětem porozumět světu zvířat a rostlin ve vzájemných souvislostech. V každé epizodě budeme pozorovat život a chování vybraného zvířátka a vysvětlovat důležitost rostlinky, která s ním souvisí. Vydejte se i vy spolu s námi na dobrodružnou poznávací jízdu! Slovenský hudebně-naučný pořad

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (11)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu! II
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: O modrém autíčku (13)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál o dobrodružstvích modrého autíčka a jeho kamarádů. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Bílý tesák (2)
programme.desc: Klasické dílo světové dobrodružné literatury Bílý tesák od Jacka Londona ožívá ve dvanáctidílném seriálu, který je vytvořen originální animační technikou. Živá kresba zachycuje na pozadí nehostinné Aljašky v době vrcholící zlaté horečky osud psa, v jehož žilách koluje vlčí krev. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Příběhy kocoura Modroočka (1)
programme.desc: Modroočko má jemný kožíšek, velikánské modré oči, dlouhé vlasy a hebký čumáček. Je to vzdělaný kocourek, který si píše deník a bydlí u svého pána, spisovatele. Objevuje svět kolem sebe a vypráví o všech svých dvounohých a čtyřnohých přátelích. Z díry v plotu ho zachrání nový přítel - kocour Bělovous, na dovolené získá další přátele - ježka Šramotu, loveckého psa Fouska a králíka Bílé Pírko. Také se seznámí s kočičkou Kiki a popere se kvůli ní s obrovským zlomyslným kocourem Žluťákem.

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (11)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Broučci (1)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Pojďte pane, budeme si hrát (11)
programme.desc: Kreslený seriál o dvojici medvědů, kdy jeden je malý a hloupoučký. Druhý protáhlý a vychytralý s mlsným jazýčkem. Jednoho dne se potkali u Kolína a dali se do řeči. Po dlouhém klábosení o tom, jak měli geniální předky a příbuzné zjistí, že jsou bráchové a začnou si spolu hrát. Prožívají spolu mnohá dobrodružství a hry, které však nejsou ze strany toho většího zrovna čestnou zábavou. Ale malý medvídek to snáší vcelku dobře, a tak oba navozují řadu úsměvných situací...

programme.title: O Dorotce (3)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (3)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (2)
programme.desc: Jednou šli Mach a Šebestová do školy. Uviděl to pes Jonatán a bylo mu divné, že místo školních aktovek mají chlebníky. Jonatán utekl paní Kadrnožkové za nimi. Mach a Šebestová se rozhodli, že ho vezmou s sebou na školní výlet. Jen přemýšleli, jak to udělat. Napadlo je tedy, že zavolají do sluchátka a řeknou, ať Jonatána promění ve spolužáka. Přání se jim splnilo a mohli jet s celou třídou... Československý animovaný seriál (1976-1983).

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (6)
programme.desc: Jednou šel Krakonoš kolem chalupy dřevaře Josky Košků, a to právě v den, kdy se Joska ženil. Pán hor musel přece také přispět nějakým darem, a tak mu na dveře pověsil hodiny - kukačky. Jenomže dřív, než se Joska vrátil domů s nevěstou, šel kolem známý poberta Bertík. Dlouho se nerozmýšlel a šup s kukačkami do pytle. Večer se Krakonoš jako chudý pocestný vypravil k Joskovi, ale ať koukal, jak koukal, svůj dar nikde neviděl. Vtom zaslechl kukání, kolem totiž kráčel Bertík s pytlem.

programme.title: Duch soudce Pauknera
programme.desc: Vražda v čase válečném. Příběh s kriminální zápletkou na motivy tří povídek českého spisovatele Jaroslava Havlíčka. Dramatický příběh z malého českého městečka, zarámovaný válečným rokem 1916, je obestřen tajemstvím nadpřirozených sil. Přesto - jak se ukáže - je záhadná smrt stárnoucí ženy dílem člověka hnaného chorobnou touhou po majetku, jež se nezastaví ani před vraždou. Československé kriminální drama

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: U mě dobrý
programme.desc: A kde je kulička? Kamarádi z malé zahrádkářské kolonie, skořápkáři a malý velký podraz. Komedie z divokých devadesátých let, prvních let naší nové kapitalistické reality. Filmová komedie na motivy povídek Petra Šabacha, podle scénáře Petra Jarchovského a v režii Jana Hřebejka se ohlíží do devadesátých let, do doby našich prvních krůčků na novém a neprobádaném území rašícího kapitalismu v Čechách.

programme.title: Srdce v soumraku
programme.desc: Adaptace stejnojmenného románu Maryny Radoměrské. Julie Vachová přijde do nemocnice pro svého uzdraveného synka Pavla. Zdá se jí však, že došlo k záměně a že dítě není její. Ošetřovatelka omyl vyloučí. Během let Julie vychovala pět dětí, ale mnoho radosti z nich nemá. Ludvík rozhazuje peníze s barovou zpěvačkou, manikérka Anči uteče do Paříže, rozmazlený Petr mámí z matky peníze. Jeho dvojče Pavla neměla matka od příhody v nemocnici ráda, přestože on jediný z dětí jí pomáhá.

programme.title: Akcia Edelstein
programme.desc: Souboj agentů ve špionážním dramatu. Bezpečnostní orgány odhalují mezinárodní teroristickou organizaci, která se v 80. letech pokouší propašovat z Československa vzácnou kazetu s drahokamy ukrytými na slovenském území během druhé světové války. Filmová adaptace stejnojmenné novely Petra Hajdúka a Jána Niňaja. Zločinci druhé světové války stále útočí! Bezpečnostní orgány odhalují mezinárodní teroristickou organizaci, propojenou se zločinci druhé světové války.

programme.title: Skrytá historie Československa - Pokus o československé SA (3)
programme.desc: I v Československu a následně v Protektorátu existovaly ozbrojené skupiny, které chtěly kopírovat nacistické SA a co víc, dokonce se v jednu chvíli snažily převzít vládu nad čerstvě vyhlášeným Protektorátem. Český dokumentární seriál

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Štika v rybníce
programme.desc: Česká veselohra o děvčatech ve stavebnictví. Mladí zedníci, Franta Doubrava a jeho přítel Béla, se seznámí se dvěma děvčaty, Mařkou a Vlastou. V krátké době se s Mařkou znovu setkávají na svém pracovišti jako s vyučenou zedničkou. Mařka se dostává do čety Frantova otce, na pracovně zpožděný blok. Aby mohl být splněn plán, navrhuje Mařka zavedení nového způsobu práce, zdění v trojkách.

programme.title: Lev a písnička
programme.desc: O muzikantu, Ivu a písničce. Prostřednictvím alegorických postav křehkého, bezbranného harlekýna a dravé šelmy je vyslovena úvaha o převaze umění nad hrubou silou. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Brundibáři (5)
programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Brundibáři (6)
programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Řetěz
programme.desc: Lehkomyslná žena se ocitá ve spárech zločinců. Mladá zdravotní sestra Marta Kavanová je lehkomyslná manželka, kterou nezajímá, odkud její manžel bere peníze na blahobytný a bezstarostný život. Netuší, že peníze pochází nejen z podvodných kšeftů s obrazy a šperky, ale také z loupežného přepadení menší pražské pošty, během kterého jeden z Kavanových kompliců zastřelil mladou úřednici a zranil policistu.

programme.title: Myš, která prochází zdí
programme.desc: Pohádka podle komiksových příběhů populární čtveřice, ve které se odehrává vše kolem zázračné schopnosti procházet zdí. Česká animovaná pohádka

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Proč?
programme.desc: Nejen o vlajkonoších a jejich cestě vlakem. Kde se to v těch lidech bere? Rekonstrukce skutečného příběhu o vlajkonoších, kteří se utrhli ze řetězu. V roce 1985 se skupina fotbalových fanoušků a vlajkonošů pražské Sparty vydala vlakem na rozhodující ligový zápas svého týmu do Banské Bystrice. Jejich chování, ovlivněné zřejmě nedávným řáděním fanoušků na stadionu v Bruselu, se vymklo kontrole a dosáhlo míry vandalství a brutality, která tehdejší společnost zaskočila.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (52)
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun - but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (62)
programme.desc: As the Lemmings rummage through an abandoned delivery tricycle filled with strange objects, they discover a delicious treasure: Yummy-filled Chinese brioches! Grizzy steals their tasty bounty and heads off to enjoy it alone in the cabin. The Lemmings find a mask in the tricycle that terrifies anyone who looks at it when it’s being worn by someone. The Lemmings intend to use their horrific new power to recover their stolen treats.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (63)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of Yummy which is mysteriously sucked up into a strange gravestone locked with a puzzle. Grizzy smashes open the gravestone but it contains another box made of unbreakable wood protected with a codex system. Our characters crack the code and are sucked into the box in turn. They discover that to get out, they will have to resolve a series of new puzzles, each one more complex than the last.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (64)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a giant home cinema screen that transforms his favorite documentary film into an incredible light and sound experience. But his pleasure is ruined by the Lemmings’ fiesta. While he chases after his housemates to destroy their disco equipment, he discovers with astonishment that Asian clones of himself and the Lemmings are also engaged in a high-speed pursuit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (65)
programme.desc: Grizzy has anticipated everything for his birthday and plans on spending a peaceful day in the cabin doing his favorite activities. But when the Lemmings find out it’s Grizzy’s birthday, they devise other plans. Farewell, Grizzy’s peaceful day - make way for the Lemmings’ party surprises!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (66)
programme.desc: Grizzy has adopted a lamb and wants to give it a proper education. The Lemmings have only one desire: play leap-frog with the baby! Grizzy is forced to play policeman and lock the Lemmings in one of the disused tower rooms. But the Lemmings find a strange machine capable of duplicating living beings. They decide to test it out on the lamb.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (67)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun jumping up and down on the wool of the sheep. The game turns into a nightmarewhen Grizzy’s hindquarters accidentally get shaved because of the Lemmings. Grizzy grabs a pair of shears shaves the sheep. The Lemmings’ toy is gone but they discover another sheep whose coat is even bouncier.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (68)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a crate of Yummy flavored jelly. In order to enjoy the treat alone, he throws the Lemmings intothe dungeon. The Lemmings discover a book on Robin Hood and use it as inspiration to free themselves andsteal the bear’s feast. The Lemming archers confront Grizzy armed with a sword. May the battle begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (69)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a magic show in the cabin living room but Grizzy wants to get comfy andwatch TV. He evicts the Lemmings who find a strange alignment of menhirs in the Scottish moor. Bystanding in a certain spot between the ancestral stones, one Lemming is transformed into a fairy. With his magic wand, he will now be able to organize a memorable new show and above all get rid of Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (70)
programme.desc: Grizzy does not know how to put an end to the Lemmings’ new ball game. After devastating the cabinplaying dodgeball, the Lemmings admire the magic stone balls that whirl around the cabin like raginganimals. In a secret Stonehenge cavern, Grizzy discovers a glove that can stop the uncontrollable flying objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (71)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings have a new game. They fight over a crown to place on a stuffed animal in theirimage. After a first epic confrontation, Grizzy recovers the crown, but his stuffed animal has been damaged.Grizzy shoos the Lemmings far away and tries to repair his royal stuffed effigy. Meanwhile, the Lemmings discover a stuffed animal factory that might allow them to retake possession of the crown and win the match.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to take a nap but the Lemmings are goofing around astride a sheep inside the cabin. Grizzy throws the Lemmings out, but one of them is propelled into a strange crypt away from the others. When he comes into physical contact with a sharp mysterious tooth inside the crypt, the Lemming is transformed into a fearsome creature: the Were-Lemming!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (73)

Using guile, he discreetly stockshis loot inside the cabin without arousing the suspicions of the Lemmings, but they quickly catch onto his ruse. Grizzy throws the Lemmings out but he knows his peace is only temporary. He must develop an efficient anti-Lemming protection system. He opts for a hen who mistakes the Yummy jars for her eggs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (74)

The rivals throw themselves into the construction of a tower to reach their target first. Each side has his own personal style to attain the summits, and to cheat. Due to the whims of hazard - or perhaps their rush - the jar continues to slip away from them, landing in ever-higher places. Will Grizzy and the Lemmings be up to the challenge?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (75)

The Lemmings discover that the magician has locked their figurines inside a cage. They decide to play along: the Lemmings Knights challenge the Bear Magician.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (76)

Propelled far from the cabin, the Lemmings find a magic hat that can truly turn them into whatever their costume is. All the Lemmings are delighted, except one whose costume is stuck inside the cabin.

While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all - no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. programme.title: Moley (4)

programme.desc: Bolly hurts his foot and can’t go fast until it heals. Phooey! But when everyone gives him treats to cheer him up, Bolly decides he never wants his foot to heal.

programme.desc: Dr. Bigby upgrades Bot to a Bot-y Guard. When Tom breaks in and sets off Bot's defensive systems, things get out of control and Bot terrorizes the whole lab crew. Jerry and Napoleon must figure out how to disarm Bot without hurting him.

As the brothers trade grins and playful jabs, it’s clear this isn’t just teamwork, it’s a competition! This kickstarts the ultimate race, as the brothers compete to get to the top of the volcano first.

So, they each pick one big adventure—three epic Cassidy-style activities to send their parents off in unforgettable fashion! However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

When he spots the Baby Lemmings' fireflies, he decides to capture them to make a nightlight.

programme.desc: Seeing a line of ants carrying leaves and flowers gives a group of baby lemmings the idea of doing a choreography to imitate them. Seeing that their baby lemming friends like it, they decide to put on a little show. Baby Lynx discovers this and, a little jealous, decides to crash the show and put herself forward. Clumsily, she unwittingly puts an end to the show.

programme.title: Batwheels (13)
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.desc: When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as “V-8, the Super-Spy”, he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

Once on the coach Bean drives everyone mad with his anti-boredom antics.

Results are mixed. On the one hand, the "zoom oil" certainly works. On the other hand, these nerds aren't really used to having a body that can actually do things.

programme.desc: While looking for the TV remote-control device, Grizzy happens onto a box that can localize a bunch of keys thanks to its key ring, which is equipped with a tracker. Their aerobatics fascinate the she-bear that Grizzy is in love with, which gives him the idea of replacing the shopping cart with a double-seat and inviting his beloved for a sky promenade. But confiscating a wing in mid-flight is not within the reach of just any old bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (72)
programme.desc: After being frozen for millions of years, a saber-toothed bear bursts into the cabin looking for food.

programme.desc: Eleonora Daniele approfondisce i temi di stretta attualità e i principali casi di cronaca con i protagonisti che raccontano in prima persona le loro esperienze.
